notes: No waw stands between תָקוּם and תְּרַחֵם, so 'and' is added (rule 14). The anticipatory 'it' before 'is time to have pity' is rule 25's expletive and is added; the copula goes to עֵת (rule 20). Light verbs head on their complements with the object-reaching 'upon' in the verb's unit (rule 44).
